bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot*) ;; *) echo GATE_OWNER_MISMATCH; exit 61;; esac
echo USERBOT_SERVICE_STATE
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
echo USERBOT_ALLOWLISTED_CLIENT_PATHS
find scripts -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*userbot*' -o -iname '*ipc*' \) -print | sort | head -60
echo USERBOT_SESSION_FILE_PRESENT
test -e deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session && echo YES || echo UNKNOWN
echo USERBOT_SESSION_CONTENTS=NOT_READ
